notes.title: Bullet Bunny "A Box Full of Sharp Objects" Update is out now!
notes.notes:
New Hero Called Razor 
Razor is obsessed with sharp objects... get ready to slice your way through your enemies! Razor's super lays spikes everywhere while also shooting 12 sharp blades! Razor's kit brings a whole new type of build to Bullet Bunny evolving around sharp things!

New Gun & Back Gear 
To Compliment Razor, let me introduce the Baneshul! This gun shoots out a sharp blade. When this blade hits an enemy it summons another blade from below the earth, piercing from below dealing damage! Razors back-gear lets him walk over spikes and get a small buff!

Loadouts are here!  
With loadouts you can now save 3 of your favorite loadouts and quickly switch between them using the number keys! (D-pad on controllers)

Auto-Aim & Outlines! 
Auto-aim is here for those who don't like aiming! 
Outlines are here for those who have trouble tracking enemies! 
Both can be toggled in the options menu. Outlines can be toggled pressing "O" as well

New Powerup & power changes! 
New powerup: Stun Spikes! spikes have a chance to stun enemies!
Bloody Spikes now triggers when the hero walks over it!
The Bloodsword now also deals SHARP damage (previously spike damage) + your blood percent.
Spikes got a new look!

I've also been heavily optimizing Bullet Bunny Mobile! Stay tuned for news on that :)


Thank you so much for reading <3 It means a lot
Pen

notes.title: Bullet Bunny "Overhaul" Update is out now!
notes.notes:
New Hero Called K.Rot7 (Kind of like carrot?)
K.Rot7 is a cute little robot bunny that is very unique compared to the other heroes. K.Rot7 starts with 15 HP and 40 Shield Points as well as a little drone friend. Stay close to your drone as your shield regenerates even quicker! Depending on it's current shield level, K.Rot7's super will either instantly regenerate shield points or switch the drone to attack mode. 

New Hero passives (Unlockable through special hero challenges)
Pulse - Gain a DMG buff equivalent to your armor after healing more than 5 hp
Bones - When doggos explode heal 1 hp
Porter - +10% Dodge, successful dodges against projectiles trigger an additional 15% bonus for 10(s)
Mag - 10% to gain an XP when criting
Mo - Gain a speed buff when below half ammo
Payne - Blood DMG drains slower
Haze - Poisons drain quicker
Nikki - Gain 2 DMG per turret in radius (this was remove from Nozia)
Rooty - Gain ammo while stationary
Blink - 25% to gain a super when using your super
K.rot7 - +10% Speed, +10% Dodge, +10 Shield Points

3 New gun perks for each gun (Unlockable through special gun challenges) 
These range from DMG buffs to unique things like Nozia leaving a trail of poison patches, chance to summon extra doggos, mega poison explosions, & more! 

3 New Powerups!
Although powerups were not the focused on this update I couldn't resist adding these game changers!
Poison Bullets (Bullets fired from gun now poison targets) - The goal is to make poison builds less restrictive
Rooted Bones (Summon 4 doggos when stationary for 5(s) - This really gives Rooted (stationary) Builds a big buff!
Critical Blood (Gain 5% blood every critical hit) - Pain + Crit = Mad damage!

New UI Interface in the HUB 
Complete overhaul to make it easier to navigate (see below). A lot of the negative feedback was regarding the clunky HUB and UI, this should address all that and more!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904551/1d63fef760d89b920f516043c2949daa2ce21c03.png
And More!
New Currencies/loot used to purchase/unlock things. Brain Chunk, Collector trinket, and Phantoms Remnant, dropped by bosses. This completely changes the progression system and makes this much more interesting. 
New Trader in the HUB. Trader your loot to obtain other loot.
Modes now need to be unlocked, again this makes things much more interesting and exciting!
Poisons do not instantly trigger now. With the new powerup this was necessary and lines up with how most games work.
Manual Reload has been added (R, Triangle, Y on controller)

Thank you so much for reading <3 It means a lot
Pen

notes.title: Info on a huge Update coming soon
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone! 

I've been working on some major changes to Bullet Bunny regarding all the feedback since it's release and wanted to give an update on what's to come. 

HUB User Interface Overhaul
New & easier to use HUB interface! Based on a lot feedback about how clunky and hard to use the old HUB interfaces were, I've completely revamp it for a quicker & better experience. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904551/1d63fef760d89b920f516043c2949daa2ce21c03.png

Permanent Gun Perks
Upgrade your guns permanently in the HUB by completely unique challenges!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904551/bfed74b9e7ba892f77224deefd973c34baa55fcc.png

New Hero Passives
Unlock special hero passives! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904551/92cf34f97f3a94c12abd0a2681bb7e83ce4c5139.png

Progression Overhaul
Progression is more rewarding than ever with new boss drops used to purchase guns/heroes & unique ways to unlock perks & passives! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904551/f4a2645a445a418aa95fd85c0564f72ec7279c3e.png

A New Hero
Beep Boop, a new hero!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904551/4ebe3156e4784f392fab2e6f8e218930f4e19641.png

And More
New powerups, balance changes, a trader in the HUB, and more! Some things that are in the works but might not/won't make in this update are a custom loadout system, manual reload, new guns, make poisons more accessible for every gun, and new Hero spells?

Thanks so much for reading, I'm super excited to share this with you all <3
